title: Vintage Le Creuset Enzo Mari Saucepan / Casserole – Rare Design – Made in France
description:
Rare vintage Le Creuset casserole designed in the iconic minimalist style associated with Enzo Mari. A beautiful collectible piece featuring the elegant matte copper-brown enamel finish, cream interior, and original wooden handle with matching lid.
Made in France, this vintage saucepan perfectly reflects the timeless 1970s design aesthetic for which Enzo Mari creations are highly appreciated by collectors and design lovers.
Ideal both as functional cookware and as a decorative display piece for a vintage kitchen, mid-century interior, or design collection.
Very good vintage condition with light traces of age and use consistent with vintage cookware. Interior remains clean and well preserved. Minor wear visible around edges and handle attachment, adding authentic vintage character.
